findings.current: That would only be possible if the Jin Family of Taiyuan were the Alliance Leader of Shanxi rather than its hegemon.
findings.defect: The political distinction is reversed: Wolhwa says seizing the reward would be possible if the family were Shanxi’s hegemon rather than its Alliance Leader.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly contrasts 패자 with 맹주 in that order, and the distinction drives Wolhwa’s explanation of why the family cannot simply seize territory.
findings.replacement: That would only be possible if the Jin Family of Taiyuan were Shanxi’s hegemon rather than its Alliance Leader.
findings.source: 그건 태원진가가 산서성의 맹주(盟主)가 아닌 패자(霸者)일 때나 가능한 이야기예요.

findings.current: “Four hundred and five nyang, along with twenty-three iron coins.”
findings.defect: The quantity is mistranslated: 백오 is 105, not 405.
findings.rationale: The inflated bill is specifically 105 nyang and twenty-three iron coins; changing it to 405 materially alters the scene’s financial fact.
findings.replacement: “One hundred and five nyang, along with twenty-three iron coins.”
findings.source: 은자 백오 냥 하고도 철전 이십삼 냥입니다.

findings.current: “Four days ago was everything we were able to confirm. We are still gathering additional information, but…”
findings.defect: The first sentence is grammatically malformed and changes the honorific subject: the source says that what Wolhwa confirmed four days ago remains the entirety of their information.
findings.rationale: 확인하신 addresses Wolhwa honorifically as the person who confirmed the information; it does not mean that the subordinate’s group confirmed everything four days ago.
findings.replacement: “What you confirmed four days ago is all we have. We’re still gathering additional information, but…”
findings.source: 나흘 전에 확인하신 것이 전부입니다. 추가 정보를 수집하고는 있습니다만…….

findings.current: Ever since we had entered the place, she had probably seen straight through every detail of its inner workings.
findings.defect: The possessive subject is changed. The source hyperbolically says Wolhwa can see through the visitors down to their internal organs, not that she understands the inn’s inner workings.
findings.rationale: 내부 장기 refers to their internal organs and emphasizes how completely the information merchant has them under observation.
findings.replacement: Ever since we entered this place, she had probably seen right through us, down to our innards.
findings.source: 이곳에 들어온 후부터 내부 장기까지 훤히 읽히고 있는 거나 마찬가지겠지.

findings.current: “I got carried away while drawing my sword.”
findings.defect: The physical action is altered. Jin Mukyung was performing or practicing his sword technique, not merely drawing the weapon.
findings.rationale: 검을 펼치다 means to unfold or display one’s sword technique in this context; reducing it to drawing the sword changes the mechanism by which he cut down five trees.
findings.replacement: “I got carried away while practicing my swordsmanship.”

findings.current: “Come with me. To the Mount Heng Sword Sect.”
findings.defect: The invitation is recast as a directive to accompany Wolhwa rather than a proposal that they travel together.
findings.rationale: 같이 가요 is an inclusive suggestion to go together, matching Wolhwa’s later request to join Taekyung’s party.
findings.replacement: “Let’s go together. To the Mount Heng Sword Sect.”

findings.current: She’d thrown my own words right back at me.
findings.defect: The rendering loses the idiom’s disproportionate-payback joke, which says he gave a small measure and received a much larger one in return.
findings.rationale: A 말 is ten times a 되; the following sentence already explains that Wolhwa returned his own words, so this line should preserve the idiom’s comic escalation.
findings.replacement: Talk about getting paid back tenfold.

findings.defect: The English sounds as though Wolhwa is agreeing to travel together, creating momentary ambiguity immediately after Taekyung declines.
findings.rationale: Wolhwa is accepting his refusal and dropping the matter, as confirmed by Taekyung’s surprise that she gives up immediately.

findings.current: Wolhwa had trained in martial arts to a fairly advanced level among First Rate practitioners.
findings.defect: The wording weakens the explicit concept of a mature stage within the First Rate realm and misses the established realm terminology.
findings.rationale: 완숙한 경지 describes her attained realm stage, not merely a comparative level of training among a group of practitioners.
findings.replacement: Wolhwa had cultivated her martial arts to a fairly mature stage of the First Rate realm.
findings.source: 월화는 일류 중에서도 제법 완숙한 경지까지 무공을 익힌 사람이다.

summary: Two critical errors reverse the political hierarchy and inflate the final bill from 105 to 405 nyang. Several additional passages alter subjects, actions, or meaningful pragmatic cues.
